mnemonic.meaning: COBRA RUE (こぼれる): the cobra knocks your cup and the milk spills. Overflowing tears fall too.

examples.ja: コップから水がこぼれた。
examples.en: Water spilled from the glass.

items.note: Intransitive. Also 涙がこぼれる (tears fall). Kanji: 零れる.

mnemonic.meaning: COBB, BOSS (こぼす): the boss spills Cobb salad all over the desk and then complains about it.

examples.ja: コーヒーをシャツにこぼした。
examples.en: I spilled coffee on my shirt.

items.note: Transitive partner of こぼれる. Also 愚痴をこぼす (to grumble).

mnemonic.meaning: The spirit (神) passing through (経) your body. Your nerves.
mnemonic.reading: SHIN, CAKE (しんけい): kick your shin on a cake tin and feel every nerve.

examples.ja: 試験の前は神経がぴりぴりする。
examples.en: I get on edge before exams.

items.note: 神経質 = nervous, sensitive. 無神経 = insensitive.

mnemonic.meaning: The big (大) half (半). Most of it, the majority.
mnemonic.reading: TIE, HAN (たいはん): Han ties up most of the presents. The greater part.

examples.ja: 学生の大半が賛成した。
examples.en: Most of the students agreed.

items.note: Formal; ほとんど is close.

mnemonic.meaning: 尻 has 尸 (body) with 九 underneath: the bottom part of the body.
mnemonic.reading: SHE, REE (しり) sits down on her bottom with a thump.

examples.ja: 長く座っていたらお尻が痛くなった。
examples.en: My bum hurts from sitting so long.

items.note: お尻 is polite. Also the end of something: 列の尻.

mnemonic.meaning: 昼 is noon: polite お + noon. Lunchtime.
mnemonic.reading: OH, HE RUE (おひる): he rues skipping lunch at noon.

examples.ja: お昼は何を食べる?
examples.en: What are you having for lunch?

items.note: Casual for 昼ご飯 or noon.

mnemonic.meaning: 嫁 is 女 (woman) + 家 (house): the woman who joins the house. A bride.
mnemonic.reading: YO, MAY (よめ)! May is the bride today.

examples.ja: 息子の嫁はとても優しい。
examples.en: My son's wife is very kind.

items.note: Daughter-in-law, or a casual "my wife" (some find it old-fashioned).

mnemonic.meaning: 畑 is 火 (fire) + 田 (rice field): fields cleared by fire for dry crops. A farm field.
mnemonic.reading: HA, TAKE (はたけ): "Ha, take this!" The farmer hands you a carrot from the field.

examples.ja: 祖父は畑で野菜を育てている。
examples.en: My grandfather grows vegetables in his field.

items.note: 畑 is a dry field. 田 (た) is a rice paddy. A Japanese-made kanji.

mnemonic.meaning: A marriage (婚) promise (約). An engagement.
mnemonic.reading: CON YAK (こんやく): the con man gets engaged to a yak.

examples.ja: 二人は去年婚約した。
examples.en: The two of them got engaged last year.

items.note: 婚約者 = fiancé(e). 婚約指輪 = engagement ring.

mnemonic.meaning: The country (国) as one big house (家). The nation, the state.
mnemonic.reading: COCK-A (こっか)! The rooster crows the national anthem.

examples.ja: 国家の安全を守る。
examples.en: We protect the security of the nation.

items.note: The country as a political state. 国 is general. 国歌 (anthem) sounds the same.

mnemonic.meaning: 賭 has 貝 (money): you put money on it. To bet.
mnemonic.reading: CACKLE RUE (かける): you bet on the hen, she cackles, and you rue it.

examples.ja: 彼は全財産を賭けた。
examples.en: He bet everything he owned.

items.note: 命を賭ける = to risk your life. 賭け = a bet.

mnemonic.meaning: 捲 has 扌 (hand): your hand rolls up the page or sleeve. To turn over.
mnemonic.reading: MEh, COO, RUE (めくる): you turn the page with a bored "meh".

examples.ja: 本のページを捲った。
examples.en: I turned the page of the book.

items.note: Usually in kana: めくる. 腕まくり (rolling up sleeves) is related.

mnemonic.meaning: 悪 has 心 (heart) at the bottom: a bad heart. Evil.
mnemonic.reading: ACK (あく)! The evil villain chokes on his own wickedness.

examples.ja: 正義と悪の戦い。
examples.en: The battle between good and evil.

items.note: As a prefix: 悪口 (bad-mouthing), 悪影響 (bad influence).

mnemonic.meaning: 勘 has 力 (power): a hidden power to just know. Intuition.
mnemonic.reading: CAN (かん): your intuition says there's something in the can.

examples.ja: 私の勘では、彼は嘘をついている。
examples.en: My gut tells me he's lying.

items.note: 勘がいい = intuitive. 勘違い = misunderstanding.

mnemonic.meaning: 誇 has 言 (words): words that boast with pride. Honour, dignity.
mnemonic.reading: HOCKEY, REE (ほこり): you play hockey with pride. Same sound as 埃 (dust).

examples.ja: 自分の仕事に誇りを持っている。
examples.en: I take pride in my work.

items.note: Positive pride. Same reading as 埃 (dust). 自慢 is boasting.

mnemonic.meaning: 丘 looks like a little mound on flat ground. A hill.
mnemonic.reading: OKA (おか): "OK, A hill!" Let's climb it.

examples.ja: 丘の上から町が見える。
examples.en: You can see the town from the top of the hill.

items.note: Smaller than 山.

mnemonic.meaning: A small (小) house (屋). A hut, a shed.
mnemonic.reading: CO, YA (こや): "Come on, ya!" Let's hide in the hut.

examples.ja: 山の中に小さな小屋がある。
examples.en: There's a little hut in the mountains.

items.note: Also for animals: 犬小屋 (doghouse).

mnemonic.meaning: Pass (通) a trusted (信) message. Communication.
mnemonic.reading: TSU, SHIN (つうしん): you send a message by kicking two shins together. Communication!

examples.ja: 地震で通信が途絶えた。
examples.en: Communications were cut off by the earthquake.

items.note: Technical: 通信料 (data charges), 通信販売 (mail order).

mnemonic.meaning: 鎖 has 金 (metal) on the left: metal links. A chain.
mnemonic.reading: COO, SARI (くさり): the pigeon gets tangled in a sari and a chain.

examples.ja: 犬が鎖につながれている。
examples.en: The dog is on a chain.

items.note: Also figurative: 鎖を断ち切る (break the chains).

mnemonic.meaning: The present (現) generation (代). Modern times.
mnemonic.reading: GEN DIE (げんだい): Gen dies to see modern times. The present day.

examples.ja: 現代の若者は本をあまり読まない。
examples.en: Young people today don't read many books.

items.note: 現代的 = modern. 近代 (きんだい) = the modern era (roughly 1868-1945).

mnemonic.meaning: Noon (昼) food (食). Lunch.
mnemonic.reading: CHEW, SHOCK (ちゅうしょく): you chew your lunch and get a shock.

examples.ja: 会議の前に昼食をとった。
examples.en: I had lunch before the meeting.

items.note: Formal; 昼ご飯 / お昼 are everyday. 朝食 = breakfast, 夕食 = dinner.

mnemonic.meaning: Add (加) and decrease (減) until it's right. Adjustment, degree.
mnemonic.reading: CAR GEN (かげん): Gen adjusts the car's speed just right. How's your health?

examples.ja: 塩の加減がちょうどいい。
examples.en: The amount of salt is just right.

items.note: Many uses: 手加減 (going easy), いい加減 (sloppy or "enough!"), お加減 (health).

mnemonic.meaning: The sound (音) of a thing (物). A noise.
mnemonic.reading: MONO, OTTO (ものおと): you hear a mono noise... it's Otto.

examples.ja: 夜中に物音がして目が覚めた。
examples.en: A noise woke me up in the middle of the night.

items.note: An unexplained sound, often unsettling. 音 is general sound.

mnemonic.meaning: Material (料) to eat (食). Food, provisions.
mnemonic.reading: SHOCK, RYO (しょくりょう): Ryo is shocked: the food provisions are gone.

examples.ja: 一週間分の食料を買った。
examples.en: I bought a week's worth of food.

items.note: 食料 = food in general. 食糧 (same reading) is staple food like grain.

mnemonic.meaning: 係 has 亻 (person): the person tied to a job. The person in charge.
mnemonic.reading: CAW, CARRY (かかり): the crow is in charge of carrying things.

examples.ja: 係の人に聞いてください。
examples.en: Please ask the person in charge.

items.note: Usually a role: 受付係 (receptionist). In compounds: がかり.

mnemonic.meaning: The husband's (夫) person (人). A polite word for wife, Mrs.
mnemonic.reading: FOO, GIN (ふじん): the madam sips gin.

examples.ja: 大統領夫人が会場に到着した。
examples.en: The president's wife arrived at the venue.

items.note: Polite, for someone else's wife. 婦人 (also ふじん) means women in general.

mnemonic.meaning: Lose (失) your business (業). Unemployment.
mnemonic.reading: SHE'S IT, GYOZA (しつぎょう): she lost her job, so now she's it: the gyoza stand girl.

examples.ja: 工場が閉鎖されて、多くの人が失業した。
examples.en: The factory closed and many people lost their jobs.

items.note: 失業率 = unemployment rate. 失業中 = out of work. 職を失う says the same thing in plain words.

mnemonic.meaning: 像 has 亻 (person) + 象 (elephant): a statue of a person or an elephant.
mnemonic.reading: ZO (ぞう): same sound as 象 (elephant). An elephant statue.

examples.ja: 駅前に犬の像がある。
examples.en: There's a statue of a dog in front of the station.

items.note: Also image or picture: 映像 (video), 想像 (imagination).

mnemonic.meaning: Pleasure (愉) and pleasant (快). Amusing, cheerful.
mnemonic.reading: YOU KITE (ゆかい): you fly a kite. How pleasant!

examples.ja: 彼は愉快な人だ。
examples.en: He's a fun person.

items.note: 不愉快 = unpleasant, which is more common in speech.

mnemonic.meaning: 賢 has 貝 (money) at the bottom: smart enough to save money. Wise.
mnemonic.reading: CASH, KOI (かしこい): the clever koi fish saves its cash.

examples.ja: この犬はとても賢い。
examples.en: This dog is very smart.

items.note: 頭がいい is everyday. 賢い is a little more about good judgement.
